about_the_game:
Darkness rises. The train must move on.

Welcome to Voxel Tycoon's Railroad to Hell 3 — a hardcore old-school shooter born from the depths of voxel nightmares.

Defend your cursed train on its last ride through a haunted wasteland — once alive, now swarming with monsters hungry for your soul. You’ve got 3 weapons, 50 waves, and one last ticket… straight to Hell.

From the creators of Voxel Tycoon comes a terrifying spin-off packed with bullets, chaos, and retro madness.

Features

  • 3 unique weapons — each deadlier than the last

  • 3 upgrade tiers per weapon

  • 6 stats to boost your survival chances

  • 50 waves of monsters that won’t stop coming

  • Forge your own strategy — or die trying

  • A fully destructible voxel world

  • Stylish retro visuals and a furious Halloween soundtrack

  • One goal only: survive.

By buying this game, you help fuel the continued development of Voxel Tycoon — a strategy game about transportation, factory building, and mining in infinite voxel landscapes.

Thanks for keeping the train rolling… even through Hell. 🎃
